answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The kernel of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Work waits on the wander until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the jade of the next round.
